test_cases.test_name: Document Assignment and Automated Reminder Functionality Test
test_cases.objective: Verify that documents can be successfully assigned to users and groups via the vendor UI and that automated reminders are generated according to the configured schedule.
prerequisites: System installation is complete and verified
Test user accounts and groups are created
Test documents are loaded into the system
Vendor scheduler is configured and active

test_steps.action: Log into the system with administrator credentials and navigate to the document assignment module.
test_steps.expected_result: System login is successful and the document assignment interface is displayed correctly.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the document assignment UI

test_steps.action: Select a test document and assign it to a predefined test user group using the vendor's assignment interface.
test_steps.expected_result: Assignment is confirmed by the system with a success message. The assignment appears in the pending acknowledgments list.

test_steps.action: Verify that the assignment triggers the creation of a task for the assigned users and check the system logs for the reminder scheduling event.
test_steps.expected_result: Tasks are created for all users in the assigned group. The scheduler log shows a reminder event has been queued.

test_steps.action: Wait for the configured reminder interval and verify that reminder notifications are sent to the assigned users.
test_steps.expected_result: Automated reminder notifications are generated and delivered to users' inboxes or dashboards as configured.

acceptance_criteria: Documents are successfully assigned to users and groups via the vendor UI
Automated reminders are generated according to the scheduled configuration
All assignment and reminder actions are logged in the system audit trail
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail must capture user, timestamp, and action for all assignments
Assignment records must be immutable once created

test_cases.test_name: Acknowledgment Reporting and Role-Based Dashboard Verification
test_cases.objective: Validate that standard acknowledgment reports are generated correctly and that role-based dashboards provide appropriate access to tracking information for managers.
prerequisites: Test document assignments exist with mixed completion status
Manager and non-manager test accounts are available

test_steps.action: Log into the system with a manager-level test account and navigate to the role-based dashboard.
test_steps.expected_result: Dashboard loads successfully and displays acknowledgment tracking metrics and pending items relevant to the manager's scope.
data_to_capture: List of visible metrics and reports

test_steps.action: Access the standard acknowledgment report generator and execute a report for all documents assigned in the last 30 days.
test_steps.expected_result: Report generation completes successfully within acceptable time limits, displaying comprehensive acknowledgment status data.

test_steps.action: Verify the report contains all required data fields including user, document, assignment date, due date, and acknowledgment status.
test_steps.expected_result: Report includes all mandatory data elements and accurately reflects the current acknowledgment status of all assignments.
data_to_capture: List of verified data fields in report

test_steps.action: Log into the system with a non-manager test account and attempt to access the manager dashboard and reporting features.
test_steps.expected_result: Access to manager-specific features is restricted based on user role, with appropriate access denied messages.

acceptance_criteria: Standard acknowledgment reports generate accurately within performance requirements
Role-based dashboards display appropriate information based on user permissions
Report data integrity is maintained with accurate reflection of system status
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures
FDA Guidance on Part 11 Scope and Application
data_integrity_requirements: Reports must accurately reflect current system data without modification
Access controls must prevent unauthorized report generation

test_cases.test_name: Audit Trail Verification for Document Acknowledgment Process
test_cases.objective: Verify that the system maintains a complete and secure audit trail for all document assignment and acknowledgment activities as required by regulatory standards.
prerequisites: Test users with various roles created

test_steps.action: Log in as system administrator and assign a test document to multiple users using the vendor UI
test_steps.expected_result: Document assignment is successfully completed and recorded in the system

test_steps.action: Have test users log in and acknowledge the assigned document using electronic signature
test_steps.expected_result: Acknowledgment is recorded with electronic signature and timestamp

test_steps.action: Generate and review the audit trail report for the document assignment and acknowledgment activities
test_steps.expected_result: Complete audit trail shows all assignment and acknowledgment events with timestamps and user identifiers

test_steps.action: Verify audit trail entries cannot be modified or deleted by any user role
test_steps.expected_result: Audit trail records are read-only and protected from modification

acceptance_criteria: All assignment and acknowledgment events are captured in the audit trail
Audit trail entries include complete user identification and timestamps
Audit trail records are protected from modification
Audit trail meets 21 CFR Part 11 requirements for electronic records
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures
data_integrity_requirements: ALCOA+ principles must be maintained for all audit trail entries
Audit trail must be complete, consistent, and accurate
Records must be secured against tampering or deletion
urs_requirements: URS-021-007: Provide audit trail for assignments and acknowledgments
related_tests: OQ-001: Document Assignment and Automated Reminder Functionality Test
OQ-002: Acknowledgment Reporting and Role-Based Dashboard Verification

test_cases.test_name: Active Directory Integration and User Group Synchronization Test
test_cases.objective: Verify that the system correctly synchronizes user groups from Active Directory using the standard connector and maintains group membership integrity.
prerequisites: Test user groups created in Active Directory

test_steps.action: Configure the AD connector settings in the document acknowledgment system with proper authentication credentials
test_steps.expected_result: System successfully connects to Active Directory and validates credentials

test_steps.action: Initiate manual synchronization of user groups from Active Directory to the document acknowledgment system
test_steps.expected_result: User groups and members are successfully imported from Active Directory

test_steps.action: Verify that imported user groups and members match the Active Directory source data
test_steps.expected_result: All group memberships and user attributes are accurately synchronized

test_steps.action: Make changes to group membership in Active Directory and trigger synchronization
test_steps.expected_result: System detects and applies membership changes during synchronization

test_steps.action: Test assignment of documents to synchronized AD groups and verify proper user access
test_steps.expected_result: Documents are correctly assigned to all members of synchronized AD groups

acceptance_criteria: System successfully connects to and synchronizes with Active Directory
User groups and memberships are accurately maintained
Changes in AD are properly reflected in the system
Document assignments to AD groups function correctly
regulatory_basis: Data Integrity Requirements for Integrated Systems
data_integrity_requirements: User group data must maintain integrity during synchronization
Membership changes must be accurately reflected
Access rights must be properly maintained
urs_requirements: URS-021-010: Sync user groups from AD via standard connector
related_tests: OQ-001: Document Assignment and Automated Reminder Functionality Test

prerequisites: Test dataset of 10,000+ users and documents

test_steps.action: Configure system to simulate 10,000 document assignments using automated test scripts
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts all assignment requests without errors or performance degradation

test_steps.action: Monitor system performance metrics during the assignment process
test_steps.expected_result: System maintains stable performance with resource utilization within acceptable limits

test_steps.action: Verify all 10,000 assignments are properly recorded in the database
test_steps.expected_result: Complete assignment records created with accurate timestamps and user/document associations

acceptance_criteria: System processes 10,000 assignments within 24 hours
No system crashes or critical errors occur
All assignment records are accurately stored
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 compliance for electronic records
data_integrity_requirements: Assignment records must be complete and accurate
Audit trail must capture all assignment transactions
Data must be protected from unauthorized modification
related_tests: OQ-001: Document Assignment and Automated Reminder Functionality Test

Records are properly archived when retention period expires
Retention policy configuration is enforced consistently

Prevention of premature data deletion
Consistent enforcement of retention rules

test_cases.test_name: Role-Based Dashboard Functionality and Access Control Verification
test_cases.objective: Validate that role-based dashboards provide appropriate access and functionality based on user roles and permissions
prerequisites: System with multiple user roles configured
Test data with document assignments and acknowledgments
User accounts with different role assignments

test_steps.action: Log into system as a manager-level user and access the dashboard interface
test_steps.expected_result: Dashboard displays comprehensive management views including team completion status, pending acknowledgments, and reporting options

test_steps.action: Navigate through different dashboard sections and attempt to generate standard acknowledgment reports
test_steps.expected_result: All dashboard sections accessible and report generation functions operational with appropriate data displayed

test_steps.action: Log into system as a standard user and access the dashboard interface
test_steps.expected_result: Dashboard displays limited, role-appropriate information focused on individual assignments and personal completion status

Dashboard displays appropriate content for each user role
Manager functions restricted to authorized users only
Reporting features operate as expected
